children: Red River Bancshares reported a 2Q26 overview showing $2.26 billion in loans HFI, $3.31 billion in assets and continued solid capitalization.
Filed Regulation FD presentation for September 2026 conferences; presentation available on investor page.
2Q26 net income $11.8M, EPS $1.78; NIM FTE rose to 3.61% boosting net interest income.
Loans HFI $2.264B; deposits $2.905B (down 1.4% QoQ) and loans-to-deposits 77.9%.
Well-capitalized: total risk-based capital 18.76%, tangible common equity to assets 11.57%.
Strong liquidity: $195.4M liquid assets, $1.74B available borrowing capacity; $10M stock repurchase availability.
